name: What Matters To You
description: How much do you agree with each statement about your future work?
framework: Work-values dimensions common to public career-guidance frameworks. All items are original.

items.prompt: A steady, predictable income matters a lot to me.
I would choose a secure job over an exciting but uncertain one.
I don't mind if my income goes up and down from year to year.
I want to decide for myself how to do my work.
I would like to work on my own schedule.
I prefer being told exactly what to do at work.
I want my work to improve people's lives or protect the environment.
Helping my community is an important reason to choose a career.
Whether my work helps others does not matter much to me.
Earning a high salary is one of my top goals.
I would choose a well-paid job even if it were less interesting.
I would accept a lower salary to do work I love.
